style: Photorealistic industrial editorial photography; neutral lighting; no futuristic overlays. Disclaimers rendered by the webpage.

scenes.scene: A Nordic industrial engineer wearing a navy work jacket with a small readable Nordic Labs Tech Oy embroidered text patch and safety helmet, discussing paper site plans with a client inside an ordinary industrial facility. Tablet, natural daylight, authentic work environment. The outcome is assessing the site.

An engineer installing a rack-mounted server in a modest clean industrial server room. Open rack, network cables, hands carefully connecting hardware. Grounded practical equipment, no glowing AI core.
An engineer commissioning a realistic unbranded quadruped inspection robot beside a grounded inspection drone in an industrial service bay. Both robots stationary, practical tools, no sci-fi.

Two engineers at an industrial office desk connecting inspection records to enterprise systems. Two monitors show restrained generic schedule rows and a simple building model, no readable interface text, real keyboards and cables.
An industrial engineer comparing a laptop inspection report with an actual mechanical pump and sensor readings on the factory floor. Calm careful verification, realistic tools and PPE.

An engineer in a navy Nordic Labs Tech Oy work jacket training two customer operations staff beside an inspection robot and laptop in an ordinary modern industrial facility. Collaborative handover, candid professional photograph.
